rationale: The breakout thesis has structurally failed: after tagging $25.44, price has made a series of lower highs and lower lows over the last several candles and has slipped below the 9-EMA ($25.33), which was the key momentum anchor. Volume in the final four bars is sharply collapsed (2,380–3,030 range vs. the entry surge), confirming buyers have stepped away rather than absorbing supply for a continuation move. With price drifting toward the invalidation level on thinning participation and no news catalyst to revive the thesis, closing now preserves remaining capital rather than letting the stop get tested.
